scanNote: 18b-mashqda rasmlarni RAQAMLASH faqat kassetadagi dizayner tavsifiga qarab bajariladi (kitobda faqat Stiv '1' deb belgilangan). Shuning uchun raqamlar o'rniga har bir odamning kiyimi to'liq tasvirlab berilgan — bu mashqning ikkinchi qismi ('describe each person's clothes') audio talab qilmaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and the names of the clothes. Use words from the list to fill in the gaps.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga va kiyim nomlariga qarang. Ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: hat, shorts, tie, trousers, skirt, blouse

RASMDA YETTI ODAM VA ULARNING KIYIMI:

  PAUL   — to'q rangli KOSTYUM, ko'ylak va bo'yindagi a) ......
  STEVE  — qora jemper, katakli b) ...... , jigarrang tuflilar
  LUCY   — keng chetli c) ...... , uzun gulli ko'ylak, qizil etiklar
  JOHN   — charm kurtka, futbolka, charm d) ......
  DIANA  — oq e) ...... , kurtka, pushti f) ...... , qora paypoq-shim
  MARY   — ko'ylak, futbolka, jinsi shim, sandal
  JENNY  — kepka, futbolka, paypoq, krossovka

RASMDA ALLAQACHON YOZILGAN SO'ZLAR:
  shirt, suit, jumper, shoes, dress, boots, jacket,
  T-shirt, tights, cap, socks, trainers, jeans, sandals

BU MASHQ — BUTUN UNIT LUG'ATINING JAMLANMASI.

items.whyUz:
Pol kostyum va ko'ylak kiygan; bo'yniga GALSTUK taqqan.
'a tie' /taɪ/ = galstuk. 'a suit and tie' — rasmiy kiyim.

Stiv qora jemper va KATAKLI KALTA SHIM kiygan.
'shorts' — DOIM ko'plikda.

Lyusi keng chetli SHLYAPA kiygan.
'a hat' — chetli; 'a cap' — kozirekli (Jenni kiygan).

Jon charm kurtka va charm SHIM kiygan.
'trousers' — DOIM ko'plikda (britancha; amerikacha 'pants').

Diana oq BLUZKA va uning ustidan kurtka kiygan.
'a blouse' /blaʊz/ — faqat ayollar kiyimi.

Diana pushti YUBKA kiygan, ostidan qora paypoq-shim (tights).
'a skirt' — faqat pastki qism; 'a dress' — yaxlit ko'ylak.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and number the pictures as the designer describes each one. Then, look at the pictures and describe each person's clothes.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va dizayner har birini tasvirlaganda rasmlarni raqamlang. So'ng rasmlarga qarab har bir odamning kiyimini tasvirlang.
exercises.audioRequiredUz: RAQAMLASH tartibi faqat kassetada aniqlanadi — kitobda faqat Stiv '1' deb belgilangan. Quyida mashqning IKKINCHI qismi (har bir odamning kiyimini tasvirlash) to'liq berilgan; u audio talab qilmaydi.
exercises.explanationUz:
TASVIRLASH QOLIPI:
  Ism + is wearing + kiyim1, kiyim2 and kiyim3.

ARTIKL QOIDASI:
  BIRLIK kiyim → 'a' bilan:  a hat, a dress, a jacket, a tie
  KO'PLIK kiyim → 'a' YO'Q:  shorts, trousers, jeans, boots,
                             shoes, socks, trainers, sandals,
                             tights

SANASH TARTIBI:
  Odatda YUQORIDAN PASTGA: bosh kiyim → ustki → pastki → oyoq kiyim.
  Oxirgi so'zdan oldin 'and', qolganida vergul.

items.answer: Steve is wearing a jumper, checked shorts and shoes.
items.hintUz: Qora jemper, katakli kalta shim, jigarrang tufli
items.whyUz:
Kitobda Stiv 1-raqam bilan belgilangan — demak dizayner uni BIRINCHI tasvirlaydi.
'checked' = katakli.

items.answer: Paul is wearing a suit, a shirt and a tie.
items.whyUz:
'a suit' = kostyum (pidjak + shim birga).
Uchalasi ham BIRLIK → 'a' bilan.

items.answer: Lucy is wearing a hat, a long dress and boots.
items.hintUz: Shlyapa, uzun gulli ko'ylak, qizil etik
items.whyUz:
'boots' — KO'PLIK → 'a' YO'Q.
'a long dress' — uzun ko'ylak.

items.answer: John is wearing a T-shirt, a leather jacket and leather trousers.
items.hintUz: Charm kurtka va charm shim, futbolka
items.whyUz:
'leather' = charm.
'trousers' — KO'PLIK → 'a' YO'Q.

items.answer: Diana is wearing a blouse, a jacket, a skirt and tights.
items.hintUz: Oq bluzka, kurtka, pushti yubka, qora paypoq-shim
items.whyUz:
'tights' = paypoq-shim (kolgotki) — DOIM ko'plikda.
Qolganlari birlik → 'a' bilan.

items.answer: Mary is wearing a shirt, a T-shirt, jeans and sandals.
items.whyUz:
'jeans' va 'sandals' — KO'PLIK → 'a' YO'Q.
Meri stulda o'tirgan holda tasvirlangan.

items.answer: Jenny is wearing a cap, a T-shirt, socks and trainers.
items.whyUz:
'socks' va 'trainers' — KO'PLIK → 'a' YO'Q.
Jenni beysbol tayoqchasini ushlab turibdi.

exercises.instructionEn: GAME. Choose a student in your class and describe his/her clothes. The first person to guess who you are describing goes next.
exercises.instructionUz: O'YIN. Sinfingizdan bir o'quvchini tanlang va uning kiyimini tasvirlang. Kimni tasvirlayotganingizni birinchi topgan odam keyingi navbatni oladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'YIN QOIDASI:
  1) Sinfdan bir kishini ichingizda tanlaysiz
  2) Uning kiyimini tasvirlaysiz (ISMINI aytmasdan!)
  3) Kim birinchi topsa, keyingi navbat unga o'tadi

QOLIP:
  He/She is wearing + kiyim1, kiyim2 and kiyim3.

DIQQAT: 'he' yoki 'she' dan boshlang — bu jinsni bildiradi,
lekin ismni oshkor qilmaydi.

example.speaker: S1
example.en: She is wearing a blue dress and black shoes.
example.uz: U ko'k ko'ylak va qora tufli kiygan.

example.speaker: S2
example.en: He is wearing a white shirt, grey trousers and trainers.
example.uz: U oq ko'ylak, kulrang shim va krossovka kiygan.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and tick. Listen again and repeat.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va belgilang. Yana tinglab, takrorlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI BURUN TOVUSHI:

  /n/  — oddiy 'n'. Til uchi yuqori tishlar orqasiga tegadi.
         O'zbekchadagi 'n' bilan bir xil.
         Yozilishi: n, nn
         Misollar: rain, shine, run, no, sun

  /ŋ/  — 'ng' tovushi. Til ORQASI tanglayga tegadi,
         til uchi HECH NARSAGA TEGMAYDI.
         O'zbekchada 'ng' (masalan 'ko'ngil') ga o'xshaydi.
         Yozilishi: ng, n (k/g dan oldin)
         Misollar: wearing, making, fishing, sing, long

ENG MUHIM QOIDA:
  Har qanday fe'lning -ING shakli DOIM /ŋ/ bilan tugaydi!
     wearing, making, fishing, swimming, running

  DIQQAT: /ŋ/ dan keyin 'g' O'QILMAYDI —
  'singing' = /ˈsɪŋɪŋ/, 'sin-ging' EMAS.

items.whyUz:
-ING shakli → DOIM /ŋ/.
wearing /ˈweərɪŋ/.

Oddiy 'n' bilan tugaydi → /n/.
rain /reɪn/.

-ING shakli → /ŋ/.
making /ˈmeɪkɪŋ/.

Oddiy 'n' → /n/. Oxirdagi 'e' O'QILMAYDI.
shine /ʃaɪn/.

-ING shakli → /ŋ/.
fishing /ˈfɪʃɪŋ/.

Oddiy 'n' → /n/.
run /rʌn/.
DIQQAT: 'running' esa /ˈrʌnɪŋ/ — /ŋ/ bilan tugaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures, then read the dialogue. In pairs, act out similar dialogues, using the prompts below and the words in the pictures.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang, so'ng dialogni o'qing. Juftlikda quyidagi so'zlar va rasmdagi so'zlar bilan shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
'TOO' SO'ZI — MUHIM MAVZU:

  'too' + sifat = HADDAN TASHQARI, KERAGIDAN ORTIQ
  Bu DOIM SALBIY baho beradi.

     It's too short.  = U juda kalta (kiyib bo'lmaydi)
     It's too small.  = U juda kichik (sig'maydi)

  DIQQAT — 'too' va 'very' FARQI:
     It's VERY short. = U juda kalta (shunchaki fakt)
     It's TOO short.  = U haddan tashqari kalta (YOMON)

RASMDAGI SIFATLAR (TOO...):
  tight ...... tor, siqadigan
  short ...... kalta
  small ...... kichik
  expensive .. qimmat
  long ....... uzun
  big ........ katta

BERILGAN KIYIM SO'ZLARI:
  dress, skirt, jumper, shirt, shoes, suit

KITOBDAGI DIALOG:
  SA: What do you think of this skirt?
  SB: Well, I think it's too short.
  SA: What about these shoes?
  SB: Oh no! They're too expensive.

DIQQAT — BIRLIK va KO'PLIK:
  this skirt  → IT'S too short.
  these shoes → THEY'RE too expensive.

items.question: What do you think of this skirt?
items.answer: Well, I think it's too short.
items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN namuna.
'What do you think OF ...?' — 'of' predlogi shart.
'Well, I think ...' — muloyim fikr bildirish.

items.question: What about these shoes?
items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN namuna.
'shoes' — KO'PLIK → THESE va THEY'RE.
'What about ...?' — mavzuni davom ettirish iborasi.

items.question: What do you think of this dress?
items.answer: Well, I think it's too long.
items.whyUz:
'a dress' — BIRLIK → this va it's.
Rasmda uzun binafsha ko'ylakdagi qiz — ko'ylak yerga tegib turibdi.

items.question: What about this jumper?
items.whyUz:
'a jumper' — BIRLIK → this va it's.
Rasmda qizil kalta jemperdagi yigit — jemper qorniga yetmayapti.

items.question: What do you think of this shirt?
items.answer: Well, I think it's too tight.
items.whyUz:
'tight' = tor, siqadigan.
Rasmda ko'k ko'ylakdagi erkak — tugmalari uzilib ketgan.

items.question: What about this suit?
items.whyUz:
'a suit' — BIRLIK → this va it's.
Rasmda sariq kostyumdagi yigit — kostyum unga juda katta.

items.question: What do you think of these shoes?
items.answer: Well, I think they're too big.
items.whyUz:
'shoes' — KO'PLIK → these va they're.
Rasmda katta tuflilar va £150 narx yorlig'i.

items.question: What about this skirt?
items.whyUz:
Bir kiyimni turli sifatlar bilan baholash mumkin —
o'zingiz yangi juftliklar tuzing.

groups.explanationUz: Bitta buyum bo'lgan kiyimlar oldida 'a/an' shart.
Juft yoki ikki qismli kiyimlar doim -s bilan keladi.
Ikki burun tovushi. Tilning holati bilan farqlanadi.
Ikkalasi ham kuchaytiradi, lekin baho boshqacha.
Kiyim nimadan tikilganini bildiradi. Ot oldida turadi.

patterns.formula: Ism + is wearing + kiyim1, kiyim2 and kiyim3.
patterns.exampleEn: Paul is wearing a suit, a shirt and a tie.
patterns.exampleUz: Pol kostyum, ko'ylak va galstuk kiygan.
patterns.explanationUz:
Sanashda oxirgi so'zdan oldin 'and', qolganida vergul.
BIRLIK kiyimda 'a' shart, KO'PLIKDA yo'q.

patterns.formula: What do you think OF + this/these + kiyim?
patterns.exampleEn: What do you think of this skirt? What do you think of these shoes?
patterns.exampleUz: Bu yubka haqida nima deysiz? Bu tuflilar haqida nima deysiz?
patterns.explanationUz:
'think OF' — 'of' predlogi SHART.
Birlik → this;  ko'plik → these.

patterns.formula: Well, I think it's / they're TOO + sifat.
patterns.exampleEn: Well, I think it's too short. Oh no! They're too expensive.
patterns.exampleUz: Menimcha, u juda kalta. Voy yo'q! Ular juda qimmat.
patterns.explanationUz:
'too' — SALBIY baho beradi.
Birlik → IT'S;  ko'plik → THEY'RE.
'What about ...?' — mavzuni davom ettirish yoki taklif kiritish.

patterns.exampleEn: a leather jacket, leather trousers, checked shorts, a long dress
patterns.exampleUz: charm kurtka, charm shim, katakli kalta shim, uzun ko'ylak
patterns.explanationUz: Sifat DOIM otdan OLDIN turadi va o'zgarmaydi.

patterns.formula: -ING bilan tugagan har qanday so'z → /ŋ/ tovushi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Til ORQASI tanglayga tegadi, til uchi hech narsaga tegmaydi.
Oxiridagi 'g' alohida O'QILMAYDI.
